title: Calculate COSEWIC IAO and EOO — cosewic_ranges
text: COSEWIC Index Area Occupancy (IAO; also called Area Occupancy, AOO IUCN) Extent Occurrence (EOO; IUCN well) metrics used support status assessments potentially endangered species.

title: Calculate COSEWIC IAO and EOO — cosewic_ranges
code: cosewic_ranges(   df_db,   record = "record_id",   coord_lon = "longitude",   coord_lat = "latitude",   group = "species_id",   prop_include = 1,   iao_grid_size_km = 2,   iao_grid = NULL,   iao_buffer = 500,   eoo_clip = NULL,   crs = "ESRI:102001",   which = c("eoo", "iao"),   filter_unique = FALSE,   spatial = TRUE,   species,   eoo_p )

title: Calculate COSEWIC IAO and EOO — cosewic_ranges
text: df_db Either data frame connection database naturecounts table. record Character. Name column containing record identification. coord_lon Character. Name column containing longitude. coord_lat Character. Name column containing latitude. group Character. Name column containing group identification. default species_id NatureCounts data. prop_include Numeric. proportion points include range calculations (applies IAO EOO calculations). proportion points closest centroid data retained. Defaults 1 100% points. Note may wish use 0.95 omit potential outlier points. iao_grid_size_km Numeric. Size grid (km) use calculating IAO. Default COSEWIC requirement (2km, meaning 2x2km grids 4km2). Use caution changing. iao_grid sf Polygon. Supply IAO grid rather creating one. CRS grid must crs. iao_buffer Numeric. relevant iao_grid = NULL. number km buffer map Canada creating IAO grid (defaults 500km). Helps ensure observations included, clearly external observations omitted. Note may need set quite high include oceanic islands captured Natural Earth's map Canada. eoo_clip sf (Multi)Polygon. spatial object clip EOO . May relevant calculating EOOs complex regions (.e. long curved areas) avoid including area observations. crs coordinate reference system (see ?sf::st_transform()). Defaults Albers Equal-Area Canada (ESRI:102001) area calculations. Note must projection (.e. simply reference system like 4326 used GPS) area calculations. NULL plots, uses CRS base map IAO/EOO data. Character vector. range types calculate. combination "eoo" "iao", default . filter_unique Logical. Whether filter observations unique locations. Use many data points work . changes nature observation , may also affect observations omitted using prop_include < 1. spatial Logical. Whether return sf spatial objects showing calculations. TRUE (default) returns list spatial data frames, iao eoo. FALSE returns data frame IAO EOO values. species Deprecated. Use groups. eoo_p Deprectated. User prop_include.

title: Calculate COSEWIC IAO and EOO — cosewic_ranges
text: spatial = TRUE, list two spatial data frames, iao eoo. Otherwise data frame. (Spatial) data frames contain following columns Group column (defined group, defaults species_id) n_records_total - Total number records used create ranges (filtering prop_include < 1) prop_include - proportion original points included calculations Additionally iao data frame contains grid_id - ID number grid cells n_records - Number records grid cell min_record - Minimum number records across cells max_record - Maximum number records across cells median_record - Median number records across cells grid_size_km - IAO cell size km (.e. width) n_occupied - Across cells, number IAO cells least one record iao - IAO value (grid_size_km^2 * n_occupied) Additionally eoo data frame contains eoo - EOO area calculated Convex Hull

title: Calculate COSEWIC IAO and EOO — cosewic_ranges
text: Note IUCN calls metric AOO, COSEWIC, AOO actually different measure, biological area occupancy. See "Distribution" section 'Instructions preparing COSEWIC status reports' details. default ranges calculated using points (prop_include = 1) However, working rough data want rough first pass, may wish use prop_include = 0.95 include 95% points (based distance centroid). ensure outlier observations artificially inflate EOO. Although IAO less sensitive outliers, maintain consistency data observations used range calculations. final COSEWIC assessment report, however, likely better carefully explore data ensure outliers use full data set (.e. use default prop_include = 1). IAO calculated first assessing large grids (10x large specified size). smaller grids created within large grid cells containing observations. speeds process avoiding creation grids areas observations. means plots spatial objects may grids large areas lacking observations. See examples. Details IAO EOO calculated used COSEWIC - Guidelines use Index Area Occupancy COSEWIC Assessments COSEWIC - Instructions preparing COSEWIC status reports COSEWIC - Table 2 COSEWIC quantitative criteria guidelines status assessment Wildlife Species
